description: Generic output layer for rt: global --json/--llm/--markdown flags, typed result objects with [OutputField] schema annotations, reflection-based renderers (Json, Markdown, Llm) written once and shared across commands. Adding a new format requires one new renderer file only.
ralph_instructions: Architectural rules: (1) Core/Output/ types are pure C# — no Roslyn deps. (2) Renderers must not import Command namespaces. (3) Each command migration must produce byte-for-byte identical plain-text output to the previous version — snapshot regression tests required. (4) No per-command --json/--llm flags after migration; these are global. (5) Verification every story: `dotnet build RoslynTools.slnx`, `dotnet test tests/RoslynTools.Tests/RoslynTools.Tests.csproj -v minimal`, `dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes`.

userStories.title: Output layer core types and context
userStories.description: As a command author, I want the core output abstractions (OutputFormat, OutputLevel, OutputFieldAttribute, IRtOutput, RtContext, RtSerializer) so that commands can produce typed results dispatched to a renderer.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/RoslynTools/Core/Output/OutputFormat.cs exists and defines `internal enum OutputFormat { Text, Json, Markdown, Llm }` in namespace RoslynTools.Core.Output.
File src/RoslynTools/Core/Output/OutputLevel.cs exists and defines `internal enum OutputLevel { Llm = 0, Default = 1, Detailed = 2 }` with explicit integer values.

File src/RoslynTools/Core/Output/OutputFieldAttribute.cs defines `internal sealed class OutputFieldAttribute : Attribute` with AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property), constructor (OutputLevel level, string description), and read-only Level and Description properties.
File src/RoslynTools/Core/Output/IRtOutput.cs defines `internal interface IRtOutput { void RenderText(TextWriter writer); }`.
File src/RoslynTools/Core/Output/RtContext.cs defines `internal static class RtContext` with static mutable Format (default OutputFormat.Text) and Level (default OutputLevel.Default) properties.

File src/RoslynTools/Core/Output/RtSerializer.cs defines `internal static class RtSerializer` with `Write(IRtOutput result, TextWriter? writer = null)` that defaults writer to Console.Out and dispatches on RtContext.Format to TextRenderer (Text default), JsonRenderer, MarkdownRenderer, LlmRenderer.
Stub renderer classes (TextRenderer, JsonRenderer, MarkdownRenderer, LlmRenderer) exist in Core/Output/Renderers/ and compile; may throw NotImplementedException — filled in US-209.
Unit test: RtContext defaults are OutputFormat.Text and OutputLevel.Default at test start.
Unit test: RtContext.Format and RtContext.Level are settable and readable.
Unit test: A dummy IRtOutput whose RenderText writes 'HELLO' produces 'HELLO' via RtSerializer.Write when RtContext.Format = Text.
Unit test: OutputFieldAttribute applied to a property is readable via GetCustomAttribute<OutputFieldAttribute>() and preserves Level + Description.
No existing command behavior is modified (regression: dotnet test still passes).
dotnet build RoslynTools.slnx passes.
dotnet test tests/RoslynTools.Tests/RoslynTools.Tests.csproj -v minimal passes.
dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes passes.
userStories.notes: Pure additive scaffolding. Stub renderers compile but may throw — filled in US-209. No command touches yet.

userStories.title: Reflection-based Json, Markdown, Llm and Text renderers
userStories.description: As a command author, I want the four format renderers implemented against [OutputField] metadata so that any IRtOutput can be serialized without per-command code.
acceptanceCriteria: TextRenderer.Render(IRtOutput result, TextWriter writer) calls result.RenderText(writer) and nothing else.

JsonRenderer reflects [OutputField] properties, includes fields with Level <= Detailed, recursively serializes nested IRtOutput values and IEnumerable<IRtOutput> collections, emits indented JSON using SymbolFormatter.DefaultJsonOptions.

MarkdownRenderer reflects [OutputField] properties with Level <= Default, renders top-level IRtOutput scalars as bold key-value pairs, renders IEnumerable<IRtOutput> as Markdown tables with column headers from OutputFieldAttribute.Description.
LlmRenderer emits only Level == Llm fields as compact `key: value` lines per record, with records separated by a blank line.
Unit test: a FakeResult : IRtOutput with fields at each OutputLevel produces Json that contains Llm+Default+Detailed fields.
Unit test: same FakeResult produces Markdown that contains Llm+Default fields and omits Detailed fields.
Unit test: same FakeResult produces Llm output that contains only Llm-level fields.
Unit test: a FakeResult with IReadOnlyList<FakeChild> (where FakeChild : IRtOutput) renders as a JSON array and as a Markdown table with one row per child.
Unit test: Text rendering delegates to RenderText exactly once and writes nothing else.
Unit test: Property without [OutputField] is omitted from Json, Markdown, and Llm output.
Unit test: Null IRtOutput value renders as JSON null and omitted Llm line.
dotnet build RoslynTools.slnx passes.
dotnet test tests/RoslynTools.Tests/RoslynTools.Tests.csproj -v minimal passes.
dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes passes.
userStories.notes: All renderer tests use local FakeResult fixtures in the test project. No command migration yet.

userStories.title: Global --json/--llm/--markdown flags via CommandLineBuilder middleware
userStories.description: As a user, I want `--json`, `--llm`, and `--markdown` to work on every command so that I can choose output format without per-command flags.
acceptanceCriteria: App.cs switches from root.InvokeAsync(args) to a CommandLineBuilder(root).UseDefaults().AddMiddleware(...).Build().InvokeAsync(args) pipeline.
Three Option<bool> globals added via root.AddGlobalOption: --json, --llm, --markdown, each with a short description.
Middleware runs at MiddlewareOrder.Configuration and sets RtContext.Format with precedence: --markdown > --json > --llm > Text default.
Core/IRtCommand.cs adds `public static virtual OutputFormat[] SupportedFormats` with default returning all four formats.
Core/RtCommandInfo.cs adds optional `OutputFormat[]? SupportedFormats = null` parameter; existing JsonOutput bool is preserved.
Integration test: invoking any existing command with --json sets RtContext.Format == OutputFormat.Json before handler runs.
Integration test: invoking with --markdown --json results in OutputFormat.Markdown (precedence).
Integration test: invoking with no flag leaves RtContext.Format == OutputFormat.Text.
Regression: every existing command produces identical stdout/stderr output when no format flag is passed.
Regression: dump-help and reflection-discovered command registry still work; startup assertion fires correctly.
Regression: docs/COMMANDS.md regenerates without unintended diff.
dotnet build RoslynTools.slnx passes.
dotnet test tests/RoslynTools.Tests/RoslynTools.Tests.csproj -v minimal passes.
dotnet format RoslynTools.slnx --verify-no-changes passes.
userStories.notes: No command migrated to IRtOutput yet — flags wired but unused. That is intentional.
